in_sanskrit.name: Khemchand
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khemchand एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Khemchand is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Khem’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘Chand’ meaning ‘moon’. This name is often associated with the Hindu deity Kuber, the god of wealth and the protector of the earth. In Hindu mythology, Khemchand is believed to symbolize the power and prosperity that comes from being connected to the earth.
